title: Requirement 'Payment DR' declares RPO 15 min but datastore 'sql-pay-prod' lacks replica or failover properties
rationale: Linked datastore 'sql-pay-prod' does not declare geo-replica, failover group, or equivalent recovery topology for RPO 15 min.
decisionsTaken: Parsed recovery objective on requirement without matching replica declaration on linked datastore.

title: Workload-conditioned requirement themes are incomplete

title: Requirement detected: Payment DR
